name: Bunquers de Martinet (Línea P)
story: These are not Civil War works but its aftermath. After the Republican guerrilla incursion into the Val d'Aran in October 1944, and fearing an Allied or exile invasion, the Franco regime secretly built the 'Línea P' (Pirineos) fortification line. It had thousands of concrete bunkers from the Cap de Creus to the Basque coast and was never used in combat. At Martinet in the Cerdanya a group of bunkers has been restored and opened as an interpretation park. It shows how far the regime's post-war isolation and fears shaped the frontier.
see: Restored machine-gun and anti-tank bunkers with connecting trenches, and an interpretation centre.
plan: Off the LV-4055 at Martinet; guided visits must be booked (bunquersmartinet.net, tel. +34 648 141 070).
